objective: Make GoalRun-owned ContextCell, ContextLease and ContextHandoff revisions admitted application state with a lifecycle, so a builder receives only the exact leased context its admitted role requires and a handoff re-evaluates under the receiver. The privacy dimensions the unit names — purpose, data class, redaction, retention, destination — are INHERITED from the bound PolicyBoundDataView revision and the InformationFlowLabel the lease references, never restated on the lease: canon's owner of those objects forbids parallel taint or privacy objects at this seam, and a lease that declared its own data class could claim one wider than the view it leases, which is the hole this unit exists to close.
falsifiable_claim: ContextCell, ContextLease and ContextHandoff are registered contracts (schema://ioi/applications/ioi-ai/context-cell/v1, context-lease/v1, context-handoff/v1) whose positives include the producer's OWN output byte-for-byte, and the daemon validates every record against its registered contract BEFORE the write. Seven routes under /v1/goal-orchestration/goal-runs/:id/… admit a lease, narrow it, revoke it, resolve it, admit a handoff, and accept or reject it; narrow/revoke/accept/reject are successors on the object's own stream, so genesis-versus-successor, CAS on the head and idempotent replay belong to the shared owner-scoped mutation spine rather than to this module, and no writer bucket moves. Narrowing is SUBTRACTION: leased_refs, allowed_ref_patterns, authority_scope_refs, information_flow_label_refs and permitted_recipient_roles may only shrink, denied_ref_patterns may only grow, and a ttl may not be extended or removed — each widening refuses by its own name. A lease that DECLARES an inherited dimension is refused by the request-field fence. A lease naming a view family head, the predecessor's policy-bound-data-view:// spelling, or the legacy context_lease:// identity is refused. The resolution is a read model rebuilt on every read whose permitted uses are the INTERSECTION of the bound view revisions' own allowed_uses, resolved through that plane's published reader under the caller's identity, and it states which dimensions it inherits rather than implying a policy nobody asserted. A handoff's non_grants block is constant by construction and re-asserted on the decision successor; acceptance is a candidate under the receiver's policy that copies no lease and transfers no authority. The activation lane ADMITS its implementer lease through that plane under a derived idempotency key and binds the implementer's own CELL as issued_to_ref; if the lease does not admit, GoalRun creation fails.

code_anchors.literal: The lease restates no privacy dimension

adversarial_or_fault_proof: Eight module tests, each pinning a REFUSAL rather than a shape: a lease issued to a reusable HarnessProfile (the defect the contracts made visible in the activation lane) is refused by the contract; a view family head is refused where a revision is admitted; the legacy context_lease:// identity is refused; a request declaring an inherited dimension is refused by name; every one of the five widening members refuses while the same members shrinking are admitted; a dropped denial, an extended ttl and an unbounded ttl are each widenings while a shortened ttl is not; a weakened handoff non-grant fails the registered contract. check:m4-goalrun-activation-plane 52/52 on an isolated daemon after the activation lane was rewired, including its restart-replay clause, which is the one that would notice a lease admitted twice or not at all. The three contracts' negatives were proven to be EVALUATED rather than decorative: check:architecture-contracts is drift-only (a planted defect that made a negative fixture validate left it green at exit 0 after regeneration), and the real oracle is the generated Rust test golden_fixtures_match_generated_rust_contracts, which failed by name on that defect before it was restored by copy and digest-verified.
remaining_nonclaims: NO VERIFIER YET: check:context-lease-handoff-lifecycle is unauthored, so M04.11's manifest check text is still the unresolved prefix and the unit remains a release blocker. The negative matrix over the MCP path in particular is unproven — the module tests and the activation gate exercise the native path only.

Handoffs and task briefs are still inline literals on the activation record; only the lease became an admitted revision, so the handoff lifecycle is exercised through its routes rather than through the producer.

Expiry is evaluated at resolution from the lease's status rather than by a sweep: a lease whose ttl has elapsed is not yet transitioned to expired by any producer, and the resolution refuses a non-active lease rather than computing elapsed time.

The resolution's permitted uses come from the bound views' allowed_uses only. The label plane's own axes (origin, integrity, confidentiality, instruction authority) are carried as refs and are NOT folded here; the lease names them and the labels' owner evaluates them.

Only two of ResolvedPolicyBoundDataView's accessors are published (allowed_uses, is_active), so the resolution folds those two; the view's data classes and redaction are inherited by reference rather than read here, which is the boundary its owner chose.
ACC-5 clauses 9 and N3 still carry their typed absences: the composed runner has not been re-run against this work, and no clause composes the unit's check because there is none.

verify-hypervisor-goalrun-multi-harness.mjs is the only verifier asserting on the activation record's context_leases array and it is invoked by no npm script and no CI job — an orphaned verifier, recorded here rather than relied on.
